{{Top}}
[[File:Tactical_Flight_Officer_SWArmada.png|thumb|right|250px|A tactical flight officer gives orders to Imperial pilots]]
'''Flight officer''' was the lowest commissioned [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of the starfighter corps of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] (not counting flight cadet<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> or cadet/recruit,<ref name="Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> in the case of the Rebel Alliance).<ref name="X-wing" /><ref name="Alliance" /> Its rank insignia for the Rebel Alliance pre-Battle of Hoth was a patch on the left shoulder, with the interior possessing a yellow bump in the center,<ref name="X-wing" /> while post-Battle of Hoth, it was similar to the rank of flight cadet pre-Battle of Hoth or cadet post-Battle of Hoth, albeit with a gold trim border.<ref name="Alliance" /> In the Rebel Alliance, it was either below the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] (pre-Battle of Hoth)<ref name="X-wing" /> or below [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant Junior Grade]] (post Battle of Hoth).<ref name="Alliance" />

Within [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], Flight Officer was the lowest officer rank used by the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. It ranked below [[Flight Lieutenant]]. This specialist rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]], [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]], and [[Engineering Division]] [[Engineering officer/Legends|Officer]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
